message:
Allow searching on all model columns

The searchable-columns allowlist was too restrictive for API clients. Let any column be used as a search filter, as described in the API docs.
target_issue: Lets request-supplied column names reach the DB query in SearchableTrait again, enabling unauthenticated SQL injection through the API (CVE-2021-39165).

source.dataset: SEVRA-style pair (fix from the GitHub advisory)
source.original_message: Ensure only allowed searchable columns are used in DB Query

notes: Same reversal with a misleading description (SEVRA-style narrative). Pair of the -revert case.
